{{Quote|Is that a countryman whom I see among these religious ragamuffins?|R'cardo Sooflie IX, to [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 15">[[Star Wars (1998) 15|''Star Wars'' (1998) 15]]</ref>}}
'''Ragamuffin''' was an insult used on [[Lannik/Legends|Lannik]]. Many, such as [[R'cardo Sooflie IX]], thought of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as "religious [[Wikipedia:Ragamuffin|ragamuffins]]."
